zh.title: 第一篇：禅让——一个看起来闭合的构
zh.deck: 从共识传位到家族继承。第一个构如何形成——以及它立即无法容纳的是什么。

en.title: Essay 1: Yao, Shun, and Yu — The Handoff That Looked Closed
en.nav_title: Yao, Shun, and Yu — The Handoff
en.deck: From consensus handoff to hereditary rule. How the first construct forms — and what it immediately cannot contain.

zh.title: 第二篇：夏——家天下的代价
zh.deck: 禹治水的余项变成了夏。家天下到底是政治原则还是结构性必然？

en.title: Essay 2: Xia — The Price of Dynastic Succession
en.deck: Yu's flood-control remainder became the Xia. Was hereditary rule a political principle or a structural inevitability?

zh.title: 第三篇：商——当王也是巫
zh.deck: 商王同时是祭司。神权与王权共享一个身体时，余项从哪里泄露？

en.title: Essay 3: Shang — When the King Is Also the Shaman
en.deck: The Shang king is also a shaman. When divine and royal authority share one body, where does the remainder leak?

zh.title: 第四篇：西周——周公制礼
zh.deck: 周公造礼——人类历史上第一次用制度文本代替人格权威。代价立刻到账。

en.title: Essay 4: Western Zhou — The Duke of Zhou Designs the Construct
en.deck: The Duke of Zhou designs ritual — the first time in history institutional text replaces personal authority. The cost arrives immediately.

zh.title: 第五篇：春秋——天子还在，构已经空了
zh.deck: 礼坏乐崩。构的外壳还在，但驱动它的力已经不在了。

en.title: Essay 5: Spring and Autumn — The Hollow Construct
en.nav_title: Spring and Autumn — The Hollow Construct
en.deck: Ritual collapses. The construct's shell remains; the force that once drove it does not.

zh.title: 第六篇：战国——七种构型的淘汰赛
zh.deck: 七个政体在同一个竞技场里互相淘汰。唯一能活下来的，是把法家逻辑贯彻最彻底的那个。

en.title: Essay 6: Warring States — The Elimination Round
en.deck: Seven polities eliminate each other in one arena. The survivor is the one that applied Legalist logic most completely.

zh.title: 第七篇：秦——逆相变的代价
zh.deck: 秦在十二年里凿掉了一切，然后用十五年消灭了自己。历史上最强的凿，从未造出能存活的构。

en.title: Essay 7: Qin — The Price of the Reverse Phase Transition
en.deck: Qin chiseled away everything in twelve years, then destroyed itself in fifteen. The most powerful chisel in history never built a construct that could survive.

zh.title: 第八篇：楚汉与西汉前期——从战争机器到"不折腾"
zh.deck: 黄老之治：不折腾是一种策略，也是一种余项管理哲学。

en.title: Essay 8: Chu-Han and Early Western Han — From War Machine to "Don't Make Trouble"
en.nav_title: Chu-Han & Early Han — Don't Rock the Boat
en.deck: Huang-Lao governance: don't rock the boat is a strategy, and a philosophy of remainder management.

zh.title: 第九篇：汉武帝——把余项编进构里
zh.deck: 汉武帝试图把余项编进构里——用儒家意识形态把军事扩张合法化。结果是更大的余项。

en.title: Essay 9: Emperor Wu of Han — Encoding the Remainder into the Construct
en.nav_title: Emperor Wu of Han — Weaving the Remainder
en.deck: Emperor Wu tries to weave the remainder into the construct — legitimizing military expansion through Confucian ideology. The result is a larger remainder.

zh.title: 第十篇：王莽——试图让时间倒流的人
zh.deck: 王莽是第一个试图用经典文本逆转历史的人。他失败了，因为文本无法代替物质条件。

en.title: Essay 10: Wang Mang — The Man Who Tried to Reverse Time
en.nav_title: Wang Mang — Making Time Flow Backward
en.deck: Wang Mang is the first to try reversing history using classical texts. He fails because text cannot substitute for material conditions.

zh.title: 第十一篇：东汉——3.0版的第一个完整周期
zh.deck: 东汉是中国历史上第一个完整走完一个周期的朝代：从建立到豪族坐大到崩溃。

en.title: Essay 11: Eastern Han — Version 3.0's First Complete Cycle
en.deck: Eastern Han is the first dynasty to run a complete cycle from its beginning: founding → magnate accumulation → collapse.

zh.title: 第十二篇：三国——四种构型的同台竞技
zh.deck: 三国不是乱世，是四种构并存的实验室：儒家、法家、道家、个人魅力型。

en.title: Essay 12: Three Kingdoms — Four Approaches to the Gentry Remainder
en.nav_title: Three Kingdoms — Four Types on One Stage
en.deck: Three Kingdoms is not chaos — it is a laboratory of four simultaneous construct types: Confucian, Legalist, Daoist, charismatic.

zh.title: 第十三篇：西晋与东晋十六国——3.0版的第一次长期中断
zh.deck: 从西晋到十六国，中国历史第一次出现长期中断。外来政权如何面对汉文明的余项？

en.title: Essay 13: Western Jin, Eastern Jin, and the Sixteen Kingdoms — Version 3.0's First Long Interruption
en.nav_title: Jin & Sixteen Kingdoms — The Long Interruption
en.deck: From Western Jin through the Sixteen Kingdoms, Chinese history sees its first prolonged interruption. How do conquest regimes face the Han civilization's remainder?

zh.title: 第十四篇：南北朝——两条道路的汇合
zh.deck: 两条路汇合：北方豪族体制与南方门阀文化在隋唐处汇流。两种余项叠加，一种制度涌现。

en.title: Essay 14: Northern and Southern Dynasties — Where Two Paths Meet
en.deck: Two streams converge: northern magnate institutions and southern aristocratic culture meet at the Sui-Tang juncture. Two remainders overlay, one institution emerges.

zh.title: 第十五篇：隋——唐的秦
zh.deck: 隋之于唐，一如秦之于汉：做了所有沉重的地基工作，然后倒塌，让继承者收割。

en.title: Essay 15: Sui — Tang's Qin
en.nav_title: Sui — The Qin of the Tang
en.deck: Sui is to Tang what Qin was to Han: it does all the heavy foundational work, then collapses, leaving the inheritance for its successor.

zh.title: 第十六篇：唐前期——3.5版的黄金态与隐含前提
zh.deck: 贞观之治是OS 3.5的黄金运行期。玄武门政变、武则天、安史之乱——黄金态的三个隐藏成本。

en.title: Essay 16: Early Tang — The Golden State and Its Hidden Premise
en.deck: Zhenguan is OS 3.5 running in golden mode. The Xuanwu Gate coup, Wu Zetian, the An Lushan Rebellion — three hidden costs of the golden state.

zh.title: 第十七篇：唐后期与五代——凿的频率加快，构的质量下降
zh.deck: 唐后期是余项的速度超越构的速度的时刻。五代是十五年凿一次构的极限实验。

en.title: Essay 17: Late Tang and Five Dynasties — When the Chisel Runs Faster Than the Construct
en.nav_title: Late Tang & Five Dynasties — Faster Chiseling
en.deck: Late Tang is the moment the remainder's speed exceeds the construct's speed. Five Dynasties is the extreme experiment of one construct per fifteen years.

zh.title: 第十八篇：北宋——文官构的巅峰与极限
zh.deck: 科举制的完全成熟，是宋的贡献。武将被制度性边缘化的代价，在靖康之变后一次性收账。

en.title: Essay 18: Northern Song — The Civil Construct at Its Peak
en.deck: The full maturation of the civil examination is Song's contribution. The cost of systematically marginalizing military commanders is collected in full at the Jingkang Incident.

zh.title: 第十九篇：蒙元——构从来没有真正建立过
zh.deck: 蒙古帝国是中国历史的唯一例外：征服者从未试图建构。当凿之后没有构，会发生什么？

en.title: Essay 19: Yuan — When the Construct Was Never Built
en.nav_title: Mongol Yuan — A Construct Never Built
en.deck: The Mongol Empire is the sole exception in Chinese history: conquerors who never attempted to construct. What happens when chisel is not followed by construct?

zh.title: 第二十篇：明前期——最偏执的闭合尝试
zh.deck: 朱元璋废掉宰相，设计出一个永远不能睡觉的皇帝。人类历史上最执念于闭合的构。

en.title: Essay 20: Early Ming — The Most Obsessive Closure Attempt
en.deck: Zhu Yuanzhang abolishes the prime ministership and designs an emperor who can never sleep. History's most obsessive attempt at a fully closed construct.

zh.title: 第二十一篇：明中后期——构的僵化与自我撕裂
zh.deck: 内阁票拟是宰相职能的结构性回归。万历三十年不上朝证明构可以自运行——但自运行不等于自纠错。

en.title: Essay 21: Mid-to-Late Ming — When the Construct Runs Without Anyone Driving
en.deck: The Grand Secretariat's draft-memorial system is the structural return of the prime minister function. Wanli's 30-year absence proves the construct can self-run — but self-running is not self-correction.

zh.title: 第二十二篇：明末清初——你不能只有一半
zh.deck: 1644年是历史压缩最密的一年。李自成是纯凿，南明是无力的构，清是精准的嫁接。

en.title: Essay 22: Late Ming and Early Qing — You Cannot Have Only Half
en.nav_title: Ming-Qing Transition — You Cannot Have Only Half
en.deck: 1644 is the most compressed year in history. Li Zicheng is pure chisel, the Southern Ming is a powerless construct, the Qing is a precise graft.

zh.title: 第二十三篇：清前中期——最后的调校
zh.deck: 雍正是中国历史上最高超的操作者。密折制度、军机处、摊丁入亩——三个精确的余项管理动作。

en.title: Essay 23: Early and Middle Qing — The Last Fine-Tuning
en.deck: Yongzheng is history's greatest technical operator. Secret memorials, the Grand Council, poll-tax merger — three precise remainder-management moves.

zh.title: 第二十四篇：清后期——当操作系统遇到它不认识的世界
zh.deck: 1840年不是一个更强的对手，而是一个不同类型的对手。操作系统遭遇了它没有分类的东西。

en.title: Essay 24: Late Qing — When the Operating System Met What It Could Not Name
en.nav_title: Late Qing — OS Meets the Unknown
en.deck: 1840 is not a stronger opponent — it is a different type of opponent. The operating system encounters something it has no category for.

zh.title: 收束篇：余项不消亡
zh.deck: 周期律为什么不断重演？因为人是目的，不是手段。任何为今天的人设计的构，都会被明天的人超越。

en.title: Essay 25: Closing — The Remainder Does Not Die
en.deck: Why does the cycle keep repeating? Because people are ends, not means. Any construct designed for today's people will be exceeded by tomorrow's people.
